convergence.exportInvocation: pen interactive --in <file.pen> --out <file.pen>; execute({ input: 'Export(["<frameId>", ...], "png", "<dir>")' }) — default scale 2; the .pen MUST sit at its committed lane path so the relative library import (../../../design-system/in-progress/hemlock-library.lib.pen) and the fonts (../../fonts/) resolve. Re-export verified byte-deterministic across consecutive runs (all 17 frames hash-identical across consecutive runs, all 17 pairwise distinct).
convergence.comparison: pixelmatch threshold 0.1, per-state budget 1.0% (dispatch default; states.json pixelThreshold 0.03 is the Gate-1 story-vs-pen budget, not this loop’s). Targets = NORMALIZED v002 prototype (sha256 of the pinned raw bytes verified before retheme), per-state contract roots, Chromium via playwright 1.62.1 (Chrome Headless Shell 151.0.7922.34), deviceScaleFactor 2, viewport 1280x1400. Protocol carried from v001: non-local origins denied + @font-face injection serving Heebo/Noto Serif (+italic) from the SAME design-specs TTFs the .pen references; --font-render-hinting=none --disable-font-subpixel-positioning --disable-lcd-text; transitions/animations frozen, caret hidden; fresh context per state; pointer parked at the farthest corner EXCEPT scrub-age-60 (pointer owns the state) and help-tooltip-open (bubble hides on pointerout); INTEGER-CSS-PIXEL clip of the contract root (round() convention — see R1 note), self-consistency gate (two consecutive shots byte-equal); scene extraction in the SAME session as the banked target (v001 interview-jitter law).
iterationNotes: R1 (9/15 carried states <= 1.0% against fresh v002 targets): the 15 v001 frames were exported at pen 0.3.5 and measured against newly banked v002 normalized targets — engine-identical renders reproduced v001 convergence numbers on 9 states; the 6 fractional-root modal states failed at 2-3.5% on a half-pixel registration shift. Diagnosis: clip-origin convention — v001 banked integer clips under round(), this run first used floor()/ceil().

R2 (17/17 <= 0.81%): targets re-banked under the round() clip convention (carried-state diffs collapsed to 0.04-0.52%); the two NEW frames (save-tooltip-shown, slider-override-note) generated from same-session scene extraction using the v001 conventions (per-signature text-y calibration table refitted and exact: 13 signatures, one dy each; per-box integer-css-px snapping; baked dashes; gauge annulus construction with the validated startAngle=-(150+sweep) law and conic-stop parse) — both passed first measurement (0.771% / 0.637%). Six carried modal frame heights aligned to the v002 integer clips (1 css px).

R3 (17/17 <= 0.807%, final): content-fidelity fix — the Your-Age cell’s input VALUE ("50") is not a DOM text node and was missing from the two generated frames (inside pixel budget but a text-content miss); synthesized per the v001 node convention. Worst state 0.807% (explainer-open, the v001 figure), median 0.30%.
convergence.geometryProbesRun: contract-named vectors verified against the emitted frames: THE MARKER LAW — retire marker x=286.72 (save-tooltip-shown, retire 64) / 307.2 + longevity 819.2 (slider-override-note) / carried v001 vectors intact (307.2/204.8/819.2); gauge band annulus innerRadius 0.8039, sweep 115.2deg = 48% and 143.52deg = raw 59.8% under the rounded 60% read, startAngle -(150+sweep); THE LOG-SLIDER LAW — retire fill 68.5714% (64 of 40..75) and income fill 61.30% (position 613 after PageUp); scrub panel 180px radius-2xs; tooltip 300px max-width, radius 10, exactly 8px below the Save and centred on it (rule 18); frame dims = integer contract-root clips, 17/17. All pass (selfcheck.mjs).
